eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 2:57 PM on AUG 7, 2026 Effective until 10:57 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  A SAFE Alert has been issued for the Gilbert Police Department. The Gilbert Police Department is looking for 78 year old Michael Chernek.  Michael is a white male, 5 feet 8 inches tall, 150 pounds, is bald with brown eyes and an unknown clothing description.  Michael was last seen at 9:00 AM on August 7, 2026, on foot near South Gilbert and West Warner Roads in Gilbert, Arizona.  Michael has a medical condition which may cause him to become lost or easily confused.  If you have seen Michael, please contact the Gilbert Police Department at 480-503-6500 or call 911. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
